payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_spec_whose_retired_first_is_not_retired_is_refused_naming_each stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/scheduler.py. The claim was "The queue scan refuses a candidate whose `retired_first` names an id not retired to `done/` in the scanned directory, under the `depends_on` kind, in one refusal row. The witness drives each mode, with and without `stack=True`. In each mode it drives five named ids in one candidate's list. One is queued with no task. One is queued with a task at `READY_FOR_REVIEW` that records a branch, a pushed sha and a pull request URL, and the candidate's `depends_on` names it, so under `stack=True` it qualifies as the order's stack base. One is queued with a `MERGED` task. One is declared by no spec anywhere. One is retired to `done/`. The reason names each of the first four and never names the retired one. It names `retired_first` and `done/`, holds the text `not retired`, and never holds the text `depends_on`. A candidate whose `retired_first` names only the retired id is a candidate in both modes. With one more file in `done/` that does not parse, the reason also carries the text `could not be read as a spec`, the suffix `_dependency_refusal` appends for the same blindness.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_cli.py::test_adopt_moves_a_task_whose_regate_is_green_on_the_adopted_head_to_ready_for_review, tests/test_cli.py::test_adopt_of_a_ready_task_records_the_url_and_runs_no_regate, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_spec_whose_open_parents_lie_on_no_one_chain_is_refused_naming_the_parents_off_it, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_stack_order_refuses_a_spec_with_any_dependency_outside_it_and_names_each, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_stack_order_stacks_on_the_deepest_open_parent_whatever_the_depends_on_order, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_stack_order_stacks_on_an_earlier_batchs_pushed_pull_request, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_stack_order_refuses_a_parent_it_cannot_stack_on_and_names_the_remedy, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_stack_order_refuses_a_child_whose_stack_base_pushed_nothing_in_its_latest_run, tests/test_scheduler.py::test_a_stack_order_stacks_on_one_earlier_pull_request_and_refuses_a_spec_naming_another, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
